title: Mahj Mondays at the Gillioz
seo_title: Mahj Mondays at the Gillioz in Springfield, MO
description: Mahj Mondays is an open play night for American Mahjong, where you can drop in or stay the whole time. It is for players of all skill levels who already know American Mahjong (NMJL rules); bring your own 2026 NMJL card, and several tile sets are provided. Admission is free, and an RSVP is requested via the Facebook event. It takes place Monday, December 7, 2026, from 5:30 PM to 8:30 PM at The Gallery at the Gillioz, 325 Park Central E., Springfield, MO.
